## Data-source coverage caveat

The full NSW feature tables and statewide ABS UCL extract replace the old New England-only coverage. True missing wind values still trigger missing_wind_data. Other missing features remain null and are surfaced in confidence notes; they are not imputed. The four original rules and thresholds are unchanged. The approved F16 addition missing_demand_data excludes cells lacking a scored demand proxy. The separately approved outside_nsw_land rule excludes centroids outside the committed ABS NSW state geometry (point covered_by, EPSG:3577, boundary included). All original grid cells remain present with their reasons; coarse cells may straddle a border or coast. This is not a parcel-level land-availability assessment.

NSW boundary source: `/Users/wang/Desktop/Mamba/CRFT/opt-mining-s3-10/DATA/geographic/boundaries/abs_ste_2021_national.geojson`

## Rule configuration (verbatim)

```yaml
- name: protected_area
  field: protected_area
  condition: '== True'
- name: missing_wind_data
  field: wind_speed_100m_ms
  condition: 'is_null'
- name: excessive_slope
  field: slope_deg
  condition: '> 15'
  threshold: 15
- name: urban_area
  field: urban_area
  condition: '== True'
- name: missing_demand_data
  field: demand_proxy
  condition: 'is_null'
- name: outside_nsw_land
  field: inside_nsw_land
  condition: '== False'
```

## Exclusion reason schema (machine + human readable)

Every excluded cell retains its reason(s) in three consistent forms, all derived from one rule evaluation so they can never drift:

- `exclusion_reason` — human-readable text, reasons joined with `', '` in rule-config order.
- `triggered_rules` — machine-readable rule-name codes, same delimiter and order.
- `exclusion_reasons` — a JSON list of `{"code": rule_name, "text": reason}` pairs (null for eligible cells), the paired form the S2-06 explanation engine consumes directly.

The `code` values are the frozen exclusion reason-code vocabulary — the rule `name` values in the rules config above. This vocabulary is governed by the Decision-Engine Specification §6 (frozen decision F16); adding or renaming a code follows that document's change-control process. A cell can carry multiple reasons.
